caption:
Ever notice your body gets tired when your mind is overloaded? Sometimes it feels like your brain is a battery that can drain your whole body. 
   Try this: 
   take a few deep breaths when you feel mentally drained 
   go for a short walk outside 
   write down your thoughts to clear your mind 
   🤔💆‍♀️
comments_seeded: What's the weirdest way your body reacts when you're mentally exhausted?
I've noticed that taking breaks can help, but what if you can't take a break?
How do you guys handle mental overload on a daily basis?
Remember, taking care of your mind is just as important as taking care of your body
